round_1.description: Simulates 1-400 progression across all 7 classes and 14 builds, verifying 15 ± 1.5h convergence and zero stalls.

assertions.name: zero_progression_stalls
assertions.condition: stalled_level is None for all 14 builds

assertions.name: build_level_tolerance
assertions.condition: At least 13/14 builds strictly in [13.5h, 16.5h], max build <= 16.85h

round_2.round_name: Round 2: Key Boss Combat & Survivability Interaction
round_2.description: Evaluates boss encounters (Balrog, Hydra, Phoenix, Kundun, Selupan) against all 14 builds, measuring DPS, TTK, burst survival, and telegraph dodging.

assertions.name: all_70_encounters_winnable
assertions.condition: won == True for all 70 boss encounter combinations

assertions.name: no_trivial_zero_damage_cheesing
assertions.condition: damage_taken > 0 and ttk >= 10s for all encounters

round_3.round_name: Round 3: Cross-Class Parity & Extreme Build Stress
round_3.description: Stress tests edge builds (pure offense vs pure defense vs balanced), evaluating cross-class variance and zero degenerate builds.

assertions.name: zero_degenerate_or_broken_builds
assertions.condition: degenerate_builds_count == 0 across all extreme stat allocations
